definitions.explanation: Having or showing quick understanding and practical wisdom.

examples.japanese: ⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧{利口|りこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦よかった→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: I should have acted more wisely.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{利口|りこう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.notes: Often used for animals showing intelligence

notes:
USAGE: {利口|りこう} describes practical intelligence or cleverness, often implying quick-wittedness or wise behavior.

NUANCE: Can imply shrewdness or being street-smart, not just book-smart.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {利口|りこう} - clever, smart (practical wisdom)
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ - smart, intelligent (general)
- ⟦{賢|かしこ}い→賢い：00192_kashikoi⟧ - wise, intelligent (slightly more formal)
- ⟦{聡明|そうめい}→聡明：28251_soumei⟧ - brilliant, sagacious (formal, literary)
